title: Bug with move streak award
body:
I did not receive an award for the longest move streak today, but I closed all three rings. My iPhone shows award for 648 days, ending on previous day, and current streak is 649 days. But my Apple Watch Ultra shows current streak is 0 days with longest 648 like the iPhone.
It's seems like a bug. Can you help me?
author: DI.dit

title: Love the app, but please, add 10k steps notification
body: It’s exhausting to download more apps while I use yours only. Please, could you add the award for 10.000 steps🙏
author: Ника Ланская
